whatsappMessage:
Hi Dr. / Team M. P. Dental Care Centre,

I noticed your clinic has an outstanding 5.0★ rating across 52 reviews in Kankarbagh, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile booking website.

Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, clinic timings, aur treatment showcase integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mpdental

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team M. P. Dental Care Centre, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp appointment booking and mobile-first speed for your Kankarbagh patients. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
